data.name: Charlotta
data.gender_notes: Charlotta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic name Charlie, meaning 'man, free person'. The 'tta' suffix is derived from Old Norse, meaning 'goddess of the earth'. The name Charlotta carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Charlotta usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing freedom in the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Charlotta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charlotta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: שרלוטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם שרלוטה הוא נגזרת של השם הגרמני קרל, שפירושו אדם חופשי. הוא קשור לשם העברי קארלוס, שגם הוא מתייחס לאדם נועז וחופשי. השם שרלוטה משמש כנשית של קרל ומשקף את התכונות של חופש, עצמאות ואומץ.

in_greek.name: Χαρλώττα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χαρλώττα είναι παράγωγο του γερμανικού ονόματος Καρλ, που σημαίνει ελεύθερος άνθρωπος. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με τις ρίζες της ελευθερίας και της ανεξαρτησίας. Στην πνευματική του σημασία, το όνομα Χαρλώττα αντανακλά τις ιδιότητες του θάρρους, της αυτοπεποίθησης και της ελευθερίας.

in_latin.name: Carlotta
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Carlotta is derived from the Germanic name Carl, meaning free man. It is associated with the Latin word 'carlus,' which signifies a free and noble person. In Christian tradition, Carlotta symbolizes freedom, courage, and independence, reflecting the virtues of a strong and determined individual.

in_english.name: Charlotta
in_english.meaning: Free woman, bold and courageous person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Charlotta originates from the Germanic name Carl, meaning 'free man.' It is linked to the Hebrew and Greek roots signifying freedom, boldness, and courage. In Christian tradition, Charlotta represents a free-spirited and determined individual, embodying the virtues of independence, self-confidence, and spiritual strength. Historically, the name has been popularized in various European cultures, symbolizing a strong and courageous personality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Charlotta is believed to be of Germanic origins, with the first part being 'Charlie', which translates to 'man, free person'. During the Middle Ages, this name became popular among the feudal Germanic tribes due to its association with power, strength, and liberation. In the English-speaking world, Charlotta gained popularity during the 18th and 19th centuries, thanks to notable figures such as the queen consort of Sweden, Charlotta Amalia, and the American stateswoman, Charlotta Tucker Mason. In contemporary times, the name Charlotta has been a favorite among Christian parents, particularly in the United States and Europe.
data.spiritual_significance: The 'tta' suffix in the name Charlotta is derived from Old Norse, indicating the goddess of the earth. This connection to the earth and the natural world reaffirms the spiritual belief in the interconnectedness of all living things and the importance of respecting and nurturing the earth. Additionally, the name Charlotta holds a significant spiritual meaning for those who value the strength and resilience of their spiritual beliefs. The name emphasizes the idea of being a 'free person' in the spiritual sense, meaning one who has overcome limitations and obstacles to live a life in connection with their divine being.
